title: Ex-Prosecutor Charged With Treason in Mexico Over US Drug Raid
detail: BBC reported on Oct 21, 2026 that a former prosecutor has been charged with treason in Mexico in connection with a US drug raid. This follows the Oct 19 detention of ex-Chihuahua prosecutor César Jáuregui and the FGR treason probe tied to CIA agents in Mexico.
